note.en: A labelled globe: Muspellheim at the zenith, Ljósálfaheimr, Ásgarðr with Glasir, Iðavöllr and Himinbjörg, Vanaheimr, Miðgarðr with the world-sea and Útgarðr, Jötunheimr, Helheimr, Niflheimr with Náströnd and Hvergelmir at the nadir.
